kind.description:
Only list brands of this kind.

* `own` - Own
* `competitor` - Competitor
* `publisher` - Publisher
* `unknown` - Unknown

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

status.description:
Only list brands with this review status.

* `suggested` - Suggested
* `confirmed` - Confirmed
* `ignored` - Ignored
